text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... I... went all out!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O! That was some great racing
out
there.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You're very fast, Bakushin O. I couldn't
keep up
with you at all...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But besides that, I'm glad I was able to
run with
you today.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...I see. I suppose this means—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You must really look up to me!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well, I'm quite fast. It's only right you
do.
However!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You have your very own Flower Road.
You must
go down that path with
Bakushin haste!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I'm back from my race!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
But of course! I'm the class
representative.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However, Flower was very fast in her
own right.
To tell you the truth, it did
get quite close here
and there.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I had my first experience of this so
called
"pressure" that everyone talks
about!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well, this time around, I was able to
show the
people that I am the better
one!

Nishino Flower was strong competition,
just as I
expected. There's a good
chance she'll overtake
Bakushin O if we
move away from doing sprints...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course I do. No one should be
able to
keep up with a true class
representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...Speed! Wait, more?! When I'm already this fast?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...Gulp. What if these legs of mine give in?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I see! I'll need this if I want to Bakushin
my way up
to senior year!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Basically what you're saying is that if I
beat
Flower by a real lot, I can try out
for
medium-distance, right?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Let's win against Flower
one more
time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'll go ask her what she plans to run in
next!

Just like the Sprinters Stakes, it's a
1,200-meter
G1 race. Since Flower
didn't win this time around,
I'm confident
in saying she will try her hand at it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I see! Then I too will run in the

Takamatsunomiya Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: With this, I will prove my speed to all...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? I feel like we've talked about this
before.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Last time it went a little something like...
this?
Wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: BAKUSHIN OOO!
